summary: AsyncStorage persistence (mafia_game_state_v1) is now FULLY WORKING. All 6 PRD scenarios verified end-to-end on the public preview at viewport 414x900. Persistence layer at mafia.tsx:147-195 (load + save useEffects, hydrated flag) correctly persists 17 fields across reloads. restartGame() at line 683 intentionally KEEPS playerNames; fullResetGame() at line 708 clears AsyncStorage. PASS RATE: 6/6 PRD items + regression all green.
critical_code_review_comments: mafia.tsx is now 2129 lines — still recommend extracting persistence into /app/frontend/hooks/useMafiaPersistence.ts for testability and to bring the file below the 700-line guideline.
Save useEffect (line 183) writes on every state change; for very large `players` arrays this could thrash AsyncStorage during animation-heavy phases. Consider debouncing 200-300ms.

exitToHome() (line 714) does NOT await the last AsyncStorage.setItem before router.back(). On slow devices the last save tick may race with unmount. Currently working in tests, but worth awaiting an explicit save before navigation in future.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 6 PRD persistence scenarios + regression verified

seed_data_creation: For TEST 4 (end-restart) the testing agent injected a synthetic phase='end' state directly into localStorage to avoid playing through a full mafia game. Both tap-end-restart and the subsequent intro→start→players-phase round-trip behaved correctly with the real React state pipeline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Persistence feature shipped successfully. If iterating further, possible follow-ups: (a) debounce the save useEffect, (b) add testID-tagged toast/badge confirming auto-save (the phaseHint '• محفوظ تلقائياً' is currently text-only), (c) extract persistence into a custom hook to slim down mafia.tsx.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all previously-reported defects (iteration_9: missing AsyncStorage wiring, restartGame clearing names) have been resolved by main agent.
